facts.text: I am trying to update my professional certifications with my new last name, Walker.
I filled out the paperwork for the name change during my honeymoon.
I have all the required documents for the name change.
I have an updated social security card with my new name.
I have an updated driver's license with my new name.
I want to know whether I need a certified copy of my marriage certificate or if I can use the original.
I want to know whether a certified copy can be used for all certifications or if I need multiple copies.
I want to know whether I need to fill out a separate form for each certification or if there is a general form for all of them.
I want to know whether I need to provide additional documentation (such as proof of identity or employment) to support my name change request for the certifications.
I want to know whether I need to notify anyone else about my name change, such as my employer or state licensing boards.
